dedupe_keys.name: world waste status let s do it 2012 2013

description: World Waste Status is a data set from a 2012–2013 research and awareness project of the civic movement Let's Do It! that collected the state of waste management in almost every country. It gives, up to 2012, national waste generation per capita and in total, composition, collection and treatment shares and tonnages; estimates of greenhouse gas emissions from landfilled waste using the IPCC and LandGEM methods; and the locations and characteristics of open dumps, landfills and incinerators in each country, with the sources used. The provider is the Let's Do It! Knowledge Team, funded by Estonia's Ministry of Environment; the files were deposited on Mendeley Data by Alexandr Iscenco, with version 2 published in August 2023. Coverage is global at country level with facility points. Data are spreadsheets downloadable free under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: figures come from literature, official reports, field visits and online surveys of volunteers, so reliability varies; illegal dump estimates rest on assumptions; nothing has been updated since 2012. Simulation uses: historical facility locations and disposal shares where recent statistics are missing, for exposure of dumpsites and landfills to hazards and for regional waste capacity baselines. Related records: Waste Atlas (data-waste-atlas) and the What a Waste global database (data-what-a-waste-global-database) cover similar ground.
